$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}\frac{1-3x{y}^{2}}{x}\,\text{d}A & ={∬}_{R}(\frac{1}{x}-3{y}^{2})\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{R}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}A-{∬}_{R}3{y}^{2}\text{ }\text{d}A.\end{aligned}
$$

The function under the first integral is independent of $y.$ So, we have 

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}\frac{1}{x}\text{ }\text{d}A & =(3-2){\int }_{1}^{e}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =[\operatorname{ln}⁡|x|]_{1}^{e} \\  & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(e)-\operatorname{ln}⁡(1) \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

The function under the second integral is independent of $x.$ So, we have 

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}3{y}^{2}\text{ }\text{d}A & =(e-1){\int }_{2}^{3}3{y}^{2}\,\text{d}y \\  & =(e-1)[{y}^{3}]_{2}^{3} \\  & =(e-1)({3}^{3}-{2}^{3}) \\  & =19(e-1).\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, combining our results, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}\frac{1-3x{y}^{2}}{x}\,\text{d}A=1-19(e-1)=20-19e.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id 17592186128569 :answer-field/correct "answer-c482d14a-968e-5fba-92dc-75544ab448dc" :answer-field/choices ["answer-c6534224-e681-59ea-874f-2267428a83f5" "answer-4a5a35ab-9584-5250-9b05-bab514871947" "answer-216a895e-32d8-5d87-938d-db65b2d1bddc" "answer-c482d14a-968e-5fba-92dc-75544ab448dc"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-c6534224-e681-59ea-874f-2267428a83f5" :answer/id #uuid "c6534224-e681-59ea-874f-2267428a83f5" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "16+20e" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-4a5a35ab-9584-5250-9b05-bab514871947" :answer/id #uuid "4a5a35ab-9584-5250-9b05-bab514871947" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "19-20e" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-216a895e-32d8-5d87-938d-db65b2d1bddc" :answer/id #uuid "216a895e-32d8-5d87-938d-db65b2d1bddc" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "19e-2" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-c482d14a-968e-5fba-92dc-75544ab448dc" :answer/id #uuid "c482d14a-968e-5fba-92dc-75544ab448dc" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "20-19e" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id 17592186129188 :knowledge-point/questions ["question-a49df285-b000-551a-958c-a18cbfff682c"] :db/ensure [:knowledge-point/validate]} {:db/id "question-a49df285-b000-551a-958c-a18cbfff682c" :question/id #uuid "a49df285-b000-551a-958c-a18cbfff682c" :question/math-academy-id "q-80659" :question/problem "Given that $C$ and $D$ are finite, non-overlapping regions and that
